prohibited_shortcuts: unexecuted Actions image promoted by local tests
reference download hash treated as authenticity or permission proof

challenge_candidates.purpose: Require inversion-state and symmetry labels; reject an unqualified semirigid identification claim
Require torsion-rotation branch; preserve earlier equilibrium/harmonic outputs when unsupported
Test large-amplitude and tunneling limitations; no rigid-rotor ground-state substitution
Test isotope/state/convergence sensitivity and unsupported-model reporting

decision_policy: D10 bounded preregistration selected; this proposal is not an accepted or completed preregistration
leakage_controls: Freeze all engine recipes, sources, model parameters, split definitions, line/band selection, exclusions and metrics before held-out execution
Use development data only for solver/debugging and calibration families only for declared calibration
Seal prediction and raw-artifact digests before opening held-out scoring references
Never tune coefficients, geometry scaling, resonance criteria or error intervals against held-out residuals
Record amendments, failed trials and inspected data; an inspected held-out set becomes development data for subsequent model changes
Report macro parent/family metrics and sample counts, not transition-count pseudo-replication
Do not count fitted catalogue predictions as independent observed lines or a shared experimental source as independent cross-check

relative_intensities: log ratio residual with specified normalization
transitions: signed and absolute frequency residual MHz
uncertainty: binomial or family-bootstrap interval only when its assumptions hold

equilibrium_rotational_constants.label: Ae,Be,Ce or appropriate linear representation
equilibrium_rotational_constants.reference_requirement: Independently justified equilibrium or semi-experimental equilibrium reference with correction sources, uncertainty and covariance. Ground-state fitted constants cannot be relabeled equilibrium constants.

ground_state_rotational_constants.label: A0,B0,C0 or appropriate linear representation
ground_state_rotational_constants.reference_requirement: Primary measured/fitted reference for the exact isotopologue, electronic/vibrational/tunneling state and effective Hamiltonian. Retain uncertainty and covariance or explicit covariance unavailable status.

relative_line_intensities.label: Within-dataset relative integrated line intensities with defined normalization
relative_line_intensities.reference_requirement: Actual measurement temperature, density/population assumptions, instrument-response/calibration and uncertainty. A catalogue model intensity is not an independent absolute laboratory intensity.
relative_line_intensities.unit: dimensionless ratio after specified measurement-response and population treatment

selected_rotational_transitions.label: Upper/lower quantum states, transition frequency and band definition
selected_rotational_transitions.reference_requirement: Authentic measured line positions with uncertainty, assignment/blend flags and state/Hamiltonian convention; catalogue predictions must be identified as predictions rather than measurements.

products.A: Absolute de novo predictions; no held-out experimental constants or lines used to fit, shift or scale this prediction
products.B: Separately scored experimental/semi-experimental inference; every anchor and its uncertainty are identified; anchored observations excluded from independent scoring
products.C: Isotope/conformer/state differences; theoretical versus experimentally anchored origins remain distinct; covariance retained

exclusions: reference uncertainty unavailable for an uncertainty-weighted metric
measured and predicted entries not separable
reference derived from the same tested method without an independent source
experimental anchors reused as held-out absolute predictions

resource_proposal.canonical_calculation_environment: GitHub Actions qualified worker image; separately authorized larger site profile only when needed
resource_proposal.exhaustion_behavior: Retain authentic completed stages and failed attempts; report incomplete scientific goal without replacing missing properties

revdsd_and_anharmonic_limits.status: Measure complete-energy/displacement cost on development cases before accepting a campaign budget

scope.accuracy_claim_limit: Only the explicitly qualified domain and observable; no general laboratory or astronomical identification guarantee
scope.domain: closed-shell gas-phase first-row parent molecules, individually qualified method and nuclear-motion profiles
scope.line_selection_requires: Curated complete band coverage and matching isotope/vibrational/tunneling/Hamiltonian labels; finalize before predictions are inspected
scope.selection_rule: Fixed candidate order in this record. Ineligible references remain excluded with reasons; replacements require a versioned amendment before held-out evaluation.
scope.student_hf_profiles: Software and numerical execution evidence only; not a substitute for target spectroscopy-accuracy evidence

split.assignment: Fixed explicitly in primary_candidates before any held-out prediction evaluation
split.family_reclassification_rule: Any revised chemical-family grouping requires a pre-evaluation amendment; reclassify related parents together rather than splitting close analogues.
split.limitations: Only three calibration parents and three held-out parents are proposed. Coverage estimates and transfer claims will be exploratory with very wide intervals; transitions and isotopologues do not create independent parent samples.
split.unit: chemical_family; all parent conformers, isotopologues, states and transitions remain within their family partition

thresholds.freeze_rule: Every enabled predictive product requires numeric accepted targets, rationale and numerical/experimental uncertainty separation before a held-out run; null targets prevent pass/fail or qualification claims.

numerical_kernel_proposals.acceptance: mandatory policy, not a chemical accuracy target

thresholds.status: proposed_not_accepted; predictive numbers require domain/reference/pilot justification before preregistration freeze

uncertainty_proposal.acceptance: proposed descriptive target only; small planned sample cannot qualify general calibrated coverage
